# Securiti

> Securiti is a unified Data Command Center platform for data security posture management, AI governance, and privacy operations across enterprise environments.

Securiti provides comprehensive solutions for discovering, protecting, and governing sensitive data and AI systems at scale. The platform combines DSPM (Data Security Posture Management), AI security, compliance automation, and access governance to help enterprises manage data risks and regulatory requirements.

## Key Topics

- Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
- Data Command Center
- AI Governance
- Agent Commander
- Sensitive Data Intelligence
- Access Intelligence
- PrivacyOps
- Compliance Management
- GenAI Security
- LLM Security
- Data Discovery & Classification
- Data Breach Investigation
- Enterprise AI Risk
- Privacy Compliance
- Data Protection

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [Securiti Data Command Center](https://securiti.ai): Unified data security and AI governance platform for comprehensive data protection
- [Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)](https://securiti.ai/dspm): DSPM platform mapping data flows for vulnerability prevention and compliance
- [Data Security Management](https://securiti.ai/products/data-security): All-in-one data security solution with visibility across cloud data systems
- [Agent Commander](https://securiti.ai/agent-commander): Detect, protect, and remediate agentic AI data risks in real-time
- [Gencore](https://securiti.ai/gencore): Secure enterprise AI copilots with data governance and LLM security

## Data Governance & Protection

- [Sensitive Data Intelligence](https://securiti.ai/products/sensitive-data-intelligence): Discover, classify, and catalog sensitive data at petabyte scale with visibility
- [Access Intelligence](https://securiti.ai/products/access-intelligence): Role-based controls for sensitive data access governance and management
- [Data Breach Investigation](https://securiti.ai/products/data-breach-investigation): Automated data breach analysis for prevention and response simplification
- [Security for AI Agents and Copilots](https://securiti.ai/products/security-for-ai-agents-and-copilots): Secure AI agents and copilots with data protection and access control

## Compliance & Regulatory

- [Compliance Management](https://securiti.ai/products/compliance-management): Automated compliance management for global data and AI regulations
- [What is DSPM](https://securiti.ai/what-is-dspm): DSPM overview: data-centric approach to security posture and risk management
- [DSPM Use Cases](https://securiti.ai/dspm-use-cases): Five key DSPM use cases for enhancing organizational data security posture
